dosing_block.label: Dosing block
dosing_block.text: Drives up to 6 pumps, one at a time. A time limit in the hardware stops every pump run.

pump_cap.label: Pump
pump_cap.text: Peristaltic pump that sits on the bottle. It stores its ID and calibration value, so both stay when you replug it.

head_ph_ec.label: pH/EC sensor head
head_ph_ec.shop: pH/EC head with galvanic isolation and probes
head_ph_ec.text: Measures pH, EC and water temperature in the tank, galvanically isolated.

head_ph.label: pH sensor head
head_ph.shop: pH head with galvanic isolation and probe
head_ph.text: Measures pH in the tank, galvanically isolated. Use it with an EC sensor head when pH and EC have separate probes.

head_ec.label: EC sensor head
head_ec.shop: EC head with galvanic isolation, probe and temperature sensor
head_ec.text: Measures EC and water temperature in the tank, galvanically isolated.

head_level.label: Level sensor head
head_level.text: Measures the level in the tank. Acts as the emergency cut-off when refilling.

head_climate.label: Climate sensor head
head_climate.text: Measures air temperature and humidity in the grow area.

head_co2.label: CO2 sensor head
head_co2.text: Measures CO2 in the grow area.

shelly_plug.label: Smart plug
shelly_plug.text: Switches a 230 V device over Wi-Fi, locally without a cloud, and measures its power. Its safety settings are stored in the plug and work without the hub too.

shelly_strip4.label: Smart power strip
shelly_strip4.text: Four separately switched 230 V outlets over Wi-Fi, locally without a cloud, with power measured per outlet.

hub_outputs.label: Hub's 12 V outputs
hub_outputs.text: Two switched 12 V outputs with a time limit, e.g. for the circulation pump and the inlet valve.

tank.inlet.label: Inlet valve
tank.inlet.note: 25 min maximum run time (rationale: RAT-079); the auto-off in the device is set to 28 min here. The refill function limits more tightly. Auto-off alone does not prevent an overflow (RAT-079).

zone.vpd.label: VPD (air)
zone.vpd.note: Air VPD without leaf offset; if a source value is missing, there is no value (rationale: RAT-017). Formula FAO-56 eq. 11. Both values at most 60 s apart (own rule, assumption).

zone.humidifier.label: Humidifier
zone.humidifier.note: Assumption: 5 min maximum run time per pulse (rationale: RAT-034, RAT-073) until the climate function sets its own limits.

zone.irrigation_pump.label: Watering pump
zone.irrigation_pump.note: Assumption: at most 10 min per dose until the irrigation function sets its own limits.

functions.label: Manual dose
functions.text: Add an amount from one bottle to the tank.

functions.label: Pump calibration
functions.text: Measure each pump's flow rate with a measuring cup or a kitchen scale. Without a calibration value, the hub does not dose.

functions.label: Mix nutrient solution
functions.text: Choose a recipe and the amount of water; the hub doses in the recipe's order.

soft.why: Without a circulation pump, the mixing guide has you stir between doses.

functions.label: Tank monitoring
functions.text: Checks pH, EC and water temperature all the time. The sensor checks always run, even without an active grow cycle.

soft.why: Without a water temperature reading, the hub doesn't judge the water temperature.

functions.label: Circulation
functions.text: Circulation pump on a schedule; on before and during every dose.

soft.why: Without a level reading, there is no dry-run protection.

functions.label: pH correction
functions.text: Lowers pH in partial doses, sized from the measured effect. Always the last step, after EC.

functions.label: EC top-up
functions.text: Raises EC with the active recipe. Paired nutrients (A/B) are scaled together.

functions.label: Tank refill
functions.text: Opens the inlet valve until the calculated amount is in. The level is only the emergency cut-off.

functions.label: Water temperature check
functions.text: Checks the water temperature against your lower and upper limit. Switches nothing.

functions.label: Climate check
functions.text: Checks air temperature and humidity in the grow area. Switches nothing.

recipes.name: Zweikomponenten-Dünger
recipes.note: Allgemeine Startwerte für A+B-Dünger mit CalMag, nicht aus einem Herstellerplan. Passe sie an die Angaben deines Düngers an.
recipes.noteEn: General starting values for A+B nutrient with CalMag, not from a manufacturer chart. Adjust them to your nutrient's label.

recipes.note: Prüf die Werte vor dem Einsatz am aktuellen Plan des Herstellers. Herstellerangabe, unverbindlich; kein Bezug zum Hersteller.
recipes.noteEn: Check against the manufacturer's current chart before use. Manufacturer data, not binding; not affiliated with the manufacturer.

recipes.note: Ab Woche 3 höher und mit PK-Zusatz (Phosphor, Kalium). Prüf die Werte vor dem Einsatz am aktuellen Plan des Herstellers. Herstellerangabe, unverbindlich; kein Bezug zum Hersteller.
recipes.noteEn: Higher from week 3, plus a PK booster (phosphorus, potassium). Check against the manufacturer's current chart before use. Manufacturer data, not binding; not affiliated with the manufacturer.
